question: In which year was the Twenty Point Programme (TPP) launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Twenty Point Programme **(TPP) was launched in **1975**.
 
• It was launched by the **Government of India** under the leadership of **Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.**
 
• The TPP aimed to address the** socio-economic needs** of the count
